letter.role_title: Working Student (d/f/m) Data Engineering, AI & Digital Dashboards
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Data Engineering, AI & Digital Dashboards in the A320 Family Quality Customer Line. Building dashboards on solid data models, and recently AI applications, is what I have done so far, and I would like to apply it to aircraft quality data.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau (full-time) with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and C1 English (IELTS 8.0). I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I built a quality inspection dashboard in SAP Analytics Cloud on an ABAP CDS view data model, replacing a manual per-material check across thousands of materials
I designed SAP Datasphere data pipelines and rebuilt a manufacturer's spinning dashboard end to end during a 42-dashboard migration

I built a RAG system over PDF manuals with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions; hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898

letter.problems_section: I would build and maintain data models and dashboards in SQL and Python, help automate reporting steps and explore AI-assisted tools for the team. I have not used Google Apps Script or Google Workspace reporting yet; I learn new tools quickly, as I did when moving from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Hamburg and can work the stated part-time hours for the full contract period from January 2027. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
